limitations: Selection data and prior final findings informed this follow-up; exploratory evidence only.
Tree constraints do not imply smoothness or monotonicity on every physical drag.
Joint support diagnostics and synthetic paths do not establish empirical calibration.
Rounded reported distance/angle examples lack full coordinates; fixtures are analogues.
No goalkeeper defaults, published artifact or localized methodology values are changed.

behavior.support_note: Training-only nearest-neighbor diagnostic; no proof of calibration or realism. Primary segments have two within-reference endpoints and unchanged count features.

scene_audit.support_method: Training-only standardized retained-feature RMS nearest neighbor; deterministic reference subsample, 99th-percentile leave-one-out threshold. Zero-defender cohort separate; sentinel distance omitted. This diagnostic is not proof of realistic joint scene support or a runtime rejection rule.
